name: @librecosta/sofaraway
description: A hypnotic browser rhythm runner. Thread the gates, ride the beat.
author: librecosta

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run build:harness && npm run test:b0
scripts.test:perf: npm run build && npm run build:harness && playwright test --config playwright.b0.config.ts --grep @perf
scripts.test:compat: npm run build && npm run build:harness && playwright test --config playwright.compat.config.ts
scripts.test:stability: npm run build && npm run build:harness && playwright test --config playwright.stability.config.ts
scripts.test:sync: vitest run tests/core/transport.test.ts && npm run build:harness && playwright test --config playwright.sync.config.ts
scripts.test:release: npm run typecheck && npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.release.config.ts
scripts.build: react-router build && node tools/build-audio.mjs && node tools/build-static.mjs
